findings.title: Checkpoint control-state precedence is incorrect
findings.cause: Historical coverage is consulted before the already-derived descriptor authorization, so known unusable control references can be reported as recoverable pending state.
closure_criteria: Resolve descriptor control state and checkpoint-role authorization before chunk assembly, historical coverage, accepted-at-control lookup, snapshot loading, or history verification.
Only missing and genuinely statefully pending controls produce pending_control.
Noncanonical, wrong-kind, wrong-coordinate, statically invalid, dynamically invalid, unsupported, and role-denied controls produce invalid descriptor and dependent chunk outcomes.
Correct exactly the authorized existing expectations and add the complete signed control-state matrix.

findings.title: A known-invalid carrier can inherit an aggregate hash outcome
findings.cause: Carrier classification contains an aggregate-disposition special case, allowing a carrier with a dynamically invalid reference to inherit an excluded semantic-hash result.
closure_criteria: Derive every carrier Event outcome independently from that carrier's revision, binding, reference, authorization, and branch-local result.
Map every carrier with a dynamically invalid control reference to invalid regardless of the aggregate ChangeHash outcome.
Retain excluded only for authorized claims on statefully valid branches whose own outcome is excluded.
Add signed aggregate-excluded and known-invalid-carrier scenarios.

findings.title: Interrupted reports use an inconsistent partial-progress model
findings.cause: Interrupted construction can retain aggregate controls and semantic hashes while omitting branch-local and per-carrier outcomes, yielding neither a complete report nor constant-size no progress.
closure_criteria: Return the exact constant-size no-progress report from every incomplete public evaluation path.
Permit canonical controls, dispositions, evidence, checkpoints, manifest state, alerts, heads, and materialized state only in complete reports.
Reject every incomplete report carrying partial canonical progress or mismatched empty digests.
Remove the public partial-batch representation and prove the no-progress shape at each interruption boundary.

findings.title: Interrupted finalization is not settled at actual pass granularity
findings.cause: A coarse reserved dimension can cover several proportional passes while unused capacity is forfeited without distinguishing work that actually ran.
closure_criteria: Use independent fixed fallback and complete-report ledgers that cannot borrow from one another.
Consume each named complete-report pass immediately before the work it owns.
On interruption, forfeit unperformed complete capacity and consume only the fixed no-progress fallback passes.
Reject missing, duplicate, reordered, overrun, underflow, early-refund, and wrong-tier ledger actions.

findings.title: Target-local work accounting remains incomplete
findings.cause: Preparation collections, retained raw-byte copies, and canonical derivation still include target-proportional work without exact charging, sharing, sealed bounds, or cancellation boundaries.
closure_criteria: Meter, bound, share, make cancellable, or eliminate every target-sized collection, traversal, allocation, comparison, and copy.
Retain canonical raw change bytes once through shared immutable storage across the public evaluation path.
Charge every checkpoint, dependency, closure, canonicalization, report, digest, evidence, and invariant pass to one declared owner.
Prove exact budgets, every cancellation boundary, unrelated-evidence isolation, byte identity, and bounded deterministic scaling.

findings.title: The requirement matrix is hash-bound but not semantically exact
findings.cause: Some passing rows accept source-name matches or broad evidence whose artifact identity is exact but whose assertion does not directly prove the governing behavior.
closure_criteria: Create a closed machine-readable proof catalog binding every evidence ID to a semantic category and exact assertion contract.
Replace source-substring and unrelated or generic proof with exact named assertions or signed fixtures.
Require exact opaque compatibility evidence identifiers for every applicable row.
Reject missing, duplicate, reordered, stale, generic, category-mismatched, false-held, and scope-leaking proof.

findings.title: Unsupported-only semantic hash attribution is underspecified
findings.cause: The aggregate reducer can create an unsupported semantic ChangeHash outcome from an unverified carrier tag even though canonical change bytes and their hash were never verified.
closure_criteria: Give an unsupported carrier without verified canonical change bytes an Event outcome only.
Do not create a semantic ChangeHash record from an unverified x-tag claim.
Remove the unsupported-only aggregate semantic reducer branch for draft v1.
Add exact signed and assertion coverage for Event-only unsupported evidence.

findings.title: External assurance and publication holds remain
findings.cause: Sustained campaigns, independent review, production approval, submission, allocation, publication, and release remain unperformed or unauthorized.

source_anchors.locator: The strongest truthful local status reachable by this sequence is

closure_criteria: Keep external assurance and remote actions separate from local implementation completion.
Do not claim production readiness, publication, submission, adoption, allocation, deployment, or release.
Retain held status until every external activity receives separate authority and passes without regressing ordinary gates.

findings.title: The typed public report omits protocol revision identity and complete cross-view validation
findings.cause: The public report and its parts do not carry the evaluator's sealed revision, and construction does not yet enforce every complete and incomplete cross-view invariant required by all consumers.
closure_criteria: Add an additive ProtocolRevision member and getter to every public report and report-parts construction.
Update every complete and no-progress constructor, reevaluation consumer, serializer, loader, public API test, and documentation consumer.
Reject duplicate, unsorted, overlapping, extra, missing, or cross-view-inconsistent complete data without repair.
Reject nonempty protocol state and mismatched empty digests from every incomplete report.

findings.title: Reevaluation performs post-finalization work after an incomplete result
findings.cause: Reevaluation can continue into summary or integrity-alert comparison after either evaluation has already stopped, creating target-proportional work beyond the no-progress boundary.
closure_criteria: Return immediately when either reevaluation report is incomplete.
Perform no summary, alert, or canonical comparison after incomplete finalization.
Meter every complete-report comparison before target-sized work.
Prove the behavior at budget and cancellation boundaries with no post-stop work.

findings.title: Typed local stop causes are not preserved through every boundary
findings.cause: Some traversal paths collapse typed budget or cancellation stops and can consult caller cancellation state again while classifying an already-observed failure.
closure_criteria: Preserve the original typed budget-exhausted or cancelled cause end to end.
Observe caller cancellation only at the charging boundary that owns the work.
Do not re-query a stateful cancellation callback while relabeling an existing stop.
Add exact single-observation tests for carrier, checkpoint, and target-work interruption.

findings.title: Checkpoint internals escape complete target-work accounting
findings.cause: Checkpoint assembly, copying, graph construction, operation and dependency accounting, exact closure, and cancellation checks do not yet share one complete pass inventory.
closure_criteria: Charge or eliminate checkpoint sorting, chunk-set copies, descriptor joins, proof visits, assembly, snapshot work, and accepted-history copies.
Charge every decoded operation, dependency edge, graph edge, and exact-closure visit with checked arithmetic.
Place cancellation boundaries before every target-sized checkpoint pass.
Prove exact budgets and cancellation for authorized, invalid, incomplete, and complete checkpoints.

findings.title: Compatibility checkpoint carriers are not fully validated at ingress
findings.cause: Descriptor and chunk field, cardinality, ordering, arithmetic, and limit checks are incomplete before deferred evaluation, so malformed carrier content can reach later processing.
closure_criteria: Complete descriptor field, type, cardinality, ordering, arithmetic, and limit validation at ingress.
Complete chunk index, count, data, hash, proof-node, proof-depth, and size validation at ingress.
Prevent malformed carrier content from reaching deferred evaluation or throwing unexpectedly.
Pass exact below-limit, at-limit, and above-limit negative matrices.

findings.title: Compatibility checkpoint states and history views are conflated
findings.cause: Checkpoint evaluation does not yet preserve the exhaustive control-state table, distinct carrier coverage and accepted-at-control history, and typed unexpected failures as separate results.
closure_criteria: Implement the exhaustive missing, pending, invalid-family, and canonical-authorized descriptor-control table.
Resolve control state and checkpoint role before all chunk and history work.
Keep historical carrier coverage distinct from accepted-at-control history even when fixtures make them equal.
Remove catch-all exception masking and prove zero downstream work for known-unusable controls.

findings.title: Compatibility ingress does not enforce every sealed limit before expansion
findings.cause: Encoded input ceilings and exact content, change, manifest, control, checkpoint, graph, and arithmetic limits are not all enforced before decoding, copying, or allocation.
closure_criteria: Mirror every sealed draft-limit value independently and reject drift against the neutral registry.
Reject oversized raw event and content bytes before duplicate scanning, base64 decoding, expansion, copying, or allocation.
Enforce exact change, graph, manifest, control, membership, role, text, checkpoint, proof, and count limits with safe arithmetic.
Pass limit-minus-one, exact-limit, and limit-plus-one tests for every sealed family.

findings.title: Compatibility target work, cancellation, and scaling are incomplete
findings.cause: Target-dependent traversals, raw-byte access, memoization, checkpoint work, materialization, reports, and deterministic scheduling lack a complete counter and cancellation ownership model.
closure_criteria: Define one typed counter and named pass owner for every target-sized operation.
Replace repeated queue sorting and linear membership with deterministic indexed structures where required for bounded scaling.
Meter and cancel control, branch, ancestry, dependency, raw-byte, memo, checkpoint, materialization, report, digest, and invariant work.
Pass exact boundaries, every cancellation boundary, unrelated floods, delivery permutations, and bounded scaling regressions.

findings.title: Compatibility finalization uses one tier and insufficiently hardened work inputs
findings.cause: Fallback and complete-report work share a finalization model, while caller limits, callback results, integer arithmetic, and unexpected local failures are not uniformly validated and typed.
closure_criteria: Validate work limits, callback inputs, safe integers, checked arithmetic, and typed local failures before use.
Implement independent fixed fallback and complete-report ledgers.
Derive exact complete passes from actual retained report dimensions and consume each immediately before work.
Settle complete, interrupted, and error paths exactly and pass zero, N-minus-one, N, N-plus-one, cancellation, callback, and mutation tests.

findings.title: Compatibility report parsing repairs data instead of enforcing exact canonical shape
findings.cause: Report handling does not yet reject every unknown, missing, mistyped, duplicate, unsorted, overlapping, or cross-view-inconsistent value before normalization or deduplication.
closure_criteria: Enforce exact report keys, schema, revision, coordinate, completion, and closed value shapes.
Enforce exact semantic partitions, ordering, namespaces, carrier/hash relations, digests, checkpoints, alerts, assertions, and evidence relationships.
Reject duplicates and unsorted or mismatched inputs instead of normalizing, repairing, or silently deduplicating them.
Use the same exact parser and builder contract through evaluation, command output, conformance, comparison, and exports.

findings.title: Compatibility evidence can be changed through retained caller aliases
findings.cause: Retained maps, arrays, nested events, carrier objects, and raw bytes are not all deeply encapsulated, so caller mutation can alter indexes, evaluation input, or later output.

source_anchors.locator: The corpus is immutable after build.

closure_criteria: Deeply encapsulate every retained corpus event, tag, map, array, carrier record, and nested protocol object.
Retain one owned raw-change or chunk byte copy and expose no mutable internal view.
Ensure mutation of caller inputs or returned bytes cannot change indexes, evaluation bytes, or later reports.
Pass post-ingestion and post-return mutation tests for every retained family.

findings.title: Compatibility ordering depends on locale-sensitive comparison
findings.cause: Protocol-significant identifiers and traversal queues can use locale-sensitive ordering whose result is not a stable byte or code-unit order across environments.
closure_criteria: Replace every protocol-significant locale-sensitive comparison with an explicit byte or code-unit comparator.
Cover identifiers, hashes, actors, controls, fixture IDs, disposition records, heads, and traversal queues.
Prove locale changes cannot alter ordering, traversal, digest input, or report bytes.
Preserve byte-identical canonical output under every required delivery permutation.

findings.title: Proof can pass through source substrings or fixture-dependent omissions
findings.cause: Source-substring matching can treat symbol presence as proof, while compatibility evidence can omit exact mandatory assertions behind broad fixture or command claims.
closure_criteria: Replace source-substring proof with exact executed semantic assertion and signed-vector evidence.
Require all signed scenarios, both executions, every delivery permutation, byte-exact comparison, and deliberate mismatch rejection without conditional omission.
Bind exact public and opaque compatibility evidence identifiers to every applicable requirement and finding.
Reject skipped, generic, missing, stale, mismatched, false-held, or scope-leaking evidence before truthful closure.
